title: Header market strip: SPX and BTC charts plus a Fear & Greed sparkline
changes: The centre of the top banner now holds three small tiles: TradingView chart-only mini charts for SPX and BTCUSD (one month) and a self-drawn sparkline of the Fear & Greed index with its current value
Fear & Greed data comes from api.alternative.me (crypto index), cached for one hour in localStorage key anav.fng.v1; tiles show a quiet dash when a source is unreachable
The strip loads only after the page is idle, only on wide layouts, not with save-data, and is hidden in print
